therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: active immunization / antibody induction against Aβ
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: amyloid plaque clearance / reduction of fibrillar Aβ burden
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in brain fibrillar Aβ at week 104 as measured by florbetapir PET SUVR over composite ROIs

results.effect_size: Mean difference (ACC combined vs placebo) at week 104: -0.050 SUVR (95% CI: -0.149 to 0.050)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Robust anti-Aβ IgG and IgM antibody titers were induced in both ACC-001 dose groups throughout the study (geometric mean IgG titers up to ~12,000 U/mL at peak vs 50 U/mL in placebo), confirming immunological target engagement.
biomarker_changes: Anti-Aβ IgG titers markedly elevated in both ACC-001 arms vs placebo at all timepoints through week 104
Anti-Aβ IgM titers markedly elevated in both ACC-001 arms vs placebo at all timepoints through week 104
CSF Aβ x-42 increased numerically in ACC 10 μg arm (LS mean +75.55 μg/mL) vs placebo (-8.87 μg/mL), p=0.0648
CSF total tau decreased in ACC 10 μg arm (LS mean -27.48 μg/mL) vs placebo (+55.92 μg/mL), p=0.0327
CSF p-tau showed non-significant reductions in both ACC-001 arms vs placebo
Plasma Aβ x-40 significantly increased in ACC-001 arms vs placebo at weeks 52 and 78 (p<0.05)
Brain MRI volumetric measures (BBSI, VBSI, HBSI) showed no significant differences between ACC-001 and placebo arms
subgroup_findings: NPI total score at week 26: ACC 10 μg significantly lower than placebo (mean difference -4.26, p=0.0057)
NPI total score combined ACC+QS-21 vs placebo at week 26: mean difference -3.13, p=0.0176
NPI-D score at week 78: ACC 10 μg vs placebo mean difference -2.11, p=0.0427
RUD-Lite primary caregiver time at week 52: ACC 10 μg vs placebo mean difference -29.70 hours, p=0.0170
RUD-Lite primary caregiver time at week 78: ACC 10 μg vs placebo mean difference -64.97 hours, p=0.0490
No significant differences in NTB, FAQ, CDR-SOB, MMSE, or ADAS-Cog between ACC-001 and placebo arms
PET amyloid SUVR did not differ significantly between ACC-001 and placebo at any timepoint
safety_signals: Serious adverse events were infrequent and distributed across arms
Basal cell carcinoma (1 in ACC 10 μg arm)
Lymphoproliferative disorder (1 in ACC 10 μg arm)
Neurilemmoma benign (1 in ACC 10 μg arm)
Parathyroid tumour benign (1 in placebo arm)
Urinary tract infection (1 in ACC 10 μg arm, 1 in placebo arm)

dose_info.dose: ACC-001 3 μg or 10 μg with QS-21 50 μg
dose_info.schedule: IM on day 1, month 1, month 3, month 6, month 12, and month 18

modulation_entries.hypothesis: QS-21 acts as a saponin adjuvant intended to amplify ACC-001-induced anti-Aβ antibody titers and T-cell responses, but the combination failed to reduce amyloid burden vs placebo, so the adjuvant effect on the primary biological endpoint was not demonstrated
